subject: Tenant anomaly correlation + interactive timeline for console diagnostics
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant anomaly correlation + interactive timeline for console diagnostics

Hi team —

Quick ask from Product: Acme reported an intermittent spike last week where tenant token spend and tail latency jumped simultaneously for a small subset of routes. CS sent over a short timeline but they keep asking for a one-click way to correlate "tenant spikes -> route callchains -> recent model/variant rollouts" inside Console.

Can we scope a lightweight, investigatory surface that does three things: 
1) shows a tenant-level anomaly timeline (spikes in cost/latency/error-rate) with zoom by minute/hour,
2) correlates selected spike windows to the top 5 contributing routes (by token spend and 95p latency), and
3) surfaces recent deploys/rollouts and config changes (model version, quantization profile, batching policy) that overlapped the window?

Goals: make it fast for CS/SE to produce a single link to share with customers and for SRE oncall to triage. Not asking for full rollout yet — MVP just needs read-only queries + an exportable short summary.

Constraints to consider: we need to keep cluster query costs bounded (sampling + pre-aggregates) and avoid pulling full KV cache dumps.

Deliverables I'm thinking: a prototype mockup, a prototype SQL/ES query set for the sampler, and an ops playbook for interpreting outputs. Would like a 2-week spike proposal by EOD Monday (17th) with rough effort estimates.

cc: Beth at Acme (she's fine being looped in at high level so we can prioritize).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Product Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant anomaly correlation + interactive timeline for console diagnostics

Thanks Hannah — digging in. Initial thoughts:

- We already have minute-level aggregates for token counts and p95 latency per route stored in the metrics DB; tying those to tenant ids is straightforward but heavy if we query raw ranges.
- Suggest layered approach: 1) use precomputed tenant-route-minute anchors for first-pass, 2) if user drills into a window, run sampled raw traces (N=500) for that tenant/time-range to extract callchain footprints.
- For deploy correlation, we can surface the last 24 hours of deploy metadata from the rollout service and highlight exact overlap. We'll need a small index mapping deploys -> route ids.

I'll draft a prototype query set (attached) and a quick mockup of the timeline interactions. Two risks: retained sampling bias (we need to document when we sample) and query cost if multiple tenants/long windows are selected.

Plan to have spike proposal by Mon 17th; can anyone from SRE validate the sampling approach?

—Marissa

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant anomaly correlation + interactive timeline for console diagnostics

+1 on layered approach. Also recommend we include an "explainability" footnote on the timeline UI that shows sampling rate and the percent of calls covered by the aggregates. That will reduce customer confusion when a specific trace isn't present.

I can help validate the SQL and add a small dashboard widget that shows confidence intervals for sampled drilldowns. Happy to sync on Mon.

—Soojin (Observability SWE)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant anomaly correlation + interactive timeline for console diagnostics

Attaching a quick prototype image and a basic correlation query I used against the staging metrics cluster. The prototype shows:
- top-band: tenant timeline with markers for cost and p95 spikes
- middle: breakdown by most-contributing routes (click route to expand callchain)
- bottom: event lane (deploys/config changes) with hover detail

Notes: the staging query pulled ~3M rows but the pre-aggregate layer reduces that to <400 rows for the initial view. I added the prototype and the SQL snippet to our doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AqExampleMockDoc (linked above).

Next steps per Hannah's ask: 1) I can put a conservative estimate — 2.5 engineer-weeks to prototype the UI + pre-aggregate pipeline, plus 1 week of infra work to wire rollout-indexing. 2) Data review on sampling approach with SRE. 3) If approved, we can flip the prototype behind a feature flag and test with Acme for next quarter.

—Markus
